say:1:1321803101:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, it's been a while. How's it going?
say:1:1321803101:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, it's been a while. How's it going?
say:1:1321803101:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, it's been a while. How's it going?

say:2:1321803102:1.text: All good, thanks! You ladies look pretty great yourselves! Actually, we're here to introduce a friend to you.
say:2:1321803102:1.source_cn: 我们很好！瓦丽卡、卡列琳娜，你们看起来心情也很不错呢！...

say:3:1321803103:3.text: Drumroll, please—it's Mr. Faramor, the undead hunter!
say:3:1321803103:3.source_cn: 请允许满满隆重为你们介绍——亡灵猎人法拉莫尔先生！

choice_prompt:5:1321803103.text: Drumroll, please—it's Mr. Faramor, the undead hunter!
choice_prompt:5:1321803103.source_cn: 请允许满满隆重为你们介绍——亡灵猎人法拉莫尔先生！

say:6:1321803104:1.text: It's alright. I've heard of Mr. Faramor while praying at the temple. You have an esteemed reputation here, Sir.
say:6:1321803104:1.source_cn: 不，没关系的。我在修道院祷告时曾听到过法拉莫尔先生的名...

say:7:1321803106:1.text: It's a pleasure to make your acquaintance.
say:7:1321803106:1.source_cn: 感谢你们的认可，我很高兴认识你们。法拉莫尔，向你们致敬。

say:8:1321803107:1.text: I've always been curious—how do the undead hunters see us? Are all of us your enemies?
say:8:1321803107:1.source_cn: 法拉莫尔先生，其实我一直很好奇，一位亡灵猎人会对亡灵有...

say:9:1321803108:1.text: Frankly speaking, I once believed your existence went against nature. When the dead gain eternal life, the natural cycle will be disrupted, and the world will be thrown into disarray.
say:9:1321803108:1.source_cn: 实话说……我曾认为亡灵眷族的存在有悖于自然秩序。死者得...

say:10:1321803109:1.text: But now, I see things differently. You are part of nature, just as much as anything else. Even if you walk in shadows, that doesn't make you any less vital to this world.
say:10:1321803109:1.source_cn: 但如今我不再这么认为了。现在的我，开始试着将亡灵视为自...

say:11:1321803110:1.text: As an undead hunter, I will continue to pursue those Graveborns who bring harm to the innocent. But you—you are the heroes of Whiteridge. You are not among them.
say:11:1321803110:1.source_cn: 身为亡灵猎人，我依旧会追猎那些为非作歹、伤害生命的亡灵...

say:12:1321803111:1.text: And for that, you have my respect.
say:12:1321803111:1.source_cn: 我想，我应该向你们表达敬意。

say:13:1321803112:1.text: I appreciate that, Faramor. To me, it isn't right to judge a person's character by their faction or status. What truly matters is whether they are virtuous at heart.
say:13:1321803112:1.source_cn: 谢谢你，法拉莫尔先生。我一直认为，阵营或者身份并不是对...

say:14:1321803113:2.text: Even as a Graveborn, my resolve to purge all evil in Whiteridge and protect the weak has never wavered...
say:14:1321803113:2.source_cn: 即使死亡，即使成为亡灵，我守护白山、对抗邪恶、保护弱小...

choice_prompt:15:1321803113.text: Even as a Graveborn, my resolve to purge all evil in Whiteridge and protect the weak has never wavered...
choice_prompt:15:1321803113.source_cn: 即使死亡，即使成为亡灵，我守护白山、对抗邪恶、保护弱小的心却从未改变过……

say:16:1321803114:1.text: That's how Valka earned the God of Death's approval and gained the Sword of Death's power.
say:16:1321803114:1.source_cn: 我想也正因为如此，瓦丽卡姐姐才能得到死神大人的认可，获...

say:17:1321803115:1.text: Sword of Death? Did the God of Death bestow it upon you?
say:17:1321803115:1.source_cn: 死神之剑？难道……是来自那位死神大人的赐予？

say:18:1321803116:1.text: Yes. Thanks to the sword, I freed myself from the pain that had bound me for years and eventually defeated the Frost Furie.
say:18:1321803116:1.source_cn: 没错，也正是因为有了这把剑，我才能打碎束缚我自己内心多...

say:19:1321803117:2.text: The God of Death's weapon... General Valka, would you be so kind as to let me experience its power?
say:19:1321803117:2.source_cn: 死神大人赐予的武器……我很好奇，瓦丽卡女士，能否让我感...

say:20:1321803118:1.text: By all means! Care for a duel with me?
say:20:1321803118:1.source_cn: 当然！想要切磋一下吗，法拉莫尔先生？

choice_prompt:21:1321803118.text: By all means! Care for a duel with me?
choice_prompt:21:1321803118.source_cn: 当然！想要切磋一下吗，法拉莫尔先生？

choice:23:0:1.source_cn: 的确没错，那我就不客气了

choice:21:0:1.male: How about I be the referee?
choice:21:0:1.female: How about I be the referee?

say:26:1321803120:1.text: No problem. Both of you can come at me together.
say:26:1321803120:1.source_cn: 没问题，我不介意你们一起来。

choice:21:1:2.text: I want a taste of the sword too.
choice:21:1:2.source_cn: 我也很想试试死神之剑的力量
choice:21:1:2.male: I want a taste of the sword too.
choice:21:1:2.female: I want a taste of the sword too.
